identity.name: G-Shock DW-5600

movement.caliber: battery quartz digital module (current module 3525/3529, updated 2023)

identity.one_liner: The current-production resin square descended from the original 1983 DW-5000C that established G-Shock's shock-resistance design.

narrative.story: Casio's original G-Shock square, the DW-5000C, debuted in April 1983 after engineer Kikuo Ibe's team built and dropped-tested over 200 prototypes to meet a self-imposed 'triple 10' brief: survive a 10-meter fall, resist 10 bar of water pressure, and run 10 years on one battery. The DW-5600 variant carried that shape forward in resin, and Casio has kept the case, screw-back, and three-button layout essentially unchanged for four decades while updating the internal module — the current DW-5600E runs module 3525/3529, introduced in 2023.
narrative.collector_notes: The module number stamped inside the caseback identifies the production era (3229 from 2010, 3525/3529 from 2023); collectors track module changes more closely than case cosmetics, since the shell itself has barely changed.
